title: Automated Prediction of Dental Implant Success Using a Mask Region-Based Convolutional Neural Network on Preoperative Cone-Beam Computed Tomography Scans.
summary: Original full text describes a retrospective 210-implant cohort, preoperative CBCT, a Mask R-CNN transfer-learning classifier and clinical success/failure follow-up. On 42 held-out implants the model reached accuracy .821/AUC .790 and exceeded two human observers; small single-center dataset limits generalization. The result is reported in Cureus. The study does not establish generalization beyond its reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
